failure.error: Value cannot be converted with json.loads
failure.root_cause: Notebook embedded a doubled-brace JSON literal in a subprocess argv list. Because subprocess does not perform shell unquoting, vLLM received the malformed doubled braces literally.

resolution.fix: Generate the argument with json.dumps({"image":2,"video":0}) and round-trip it through json.loads before launching vLLM.
